hotkey._comment: kind: 'mouse_side' (side button number, e.g. '3','4') | 'keyboard' (key/combo, e.g. 'cmd+б','f8') | 'mouse' ('right'/'middle'). Hold-to-record only. NB: macOS reserves the media keys (F7–F9), so prefer a side mouse button.

stt._comment: backend: 'mlx' (default, Apple Silicon) or 'faster-whisper'. model: tiny|base|small|medium. small is the ru sweet spot.

llm._comment: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be set in the environment.
